entries.title: National Assembly v Gachagua & 66 Others
entries.principle: The Supreme Court's jurisdiction over impeachment matters is limited; the Court will not interfere with the constitutional processes of the National Assembly and the Senate absent illegality.
entries.facts: An application by the National Assembly in the Deputy President's impeachment.
entries.holding: The Supreme Court's jurisdiction over impeachment matters is limited; the Court will not interfere with the constitutional processes of the National Assembly and the Senate absent illegality.

entries.title: Gachagua & 5 Others v Maingi & 80 Others
entries.principle: The impeachment process must comply with the Constitution; the courts will review procedural irregularities and ensure that the rights of the impeached officer are respected.
entries.facts: An appeal against the High Court's decision on the Deputy President's impeachment.
entries.holding: The impeachment process must comply with the Constitution; the courts will review procedural irregularities and ensure that the rights of the impeached officer are respected.

entries.title: Mwangaza v Speaker of the Senate of Kenya; Council of Governors & 6 Others (Interested Parties)
entries.principle: The impeachment of a governor must comply with Article 181 of the Constitution and the County Governments Act; the process must afford procedural fairness and follow the prescribed steps.
entries.facts: A challenge to the impeachment of the Governor of Meru County.
entries.holding: The impeachment of a governor must comply with Article 181 of the Constitution and the County Governments Act; the process must afford procedural fairness and follow the prescribed steps.

entries.title: Gachagua & 57 Others v Speaker, National Assembly & 35 Others
entries.principle: The impeachment of the Deputy President must comply with Article 145 and Article 150 of the Constitution; the process must afford procedural fairness and follow the prescribed steps.
entries.facts: A challenge to the impeachment of the Deputy President.
entries.holding: The impeachment of the Deputy President must comply with Article 145 and Article 150 of the Constitution; the process must afford procedural fairness and follow the prescribed steps.

entries.title: Law Society of Kenya & Another v Waititu & 3 Others
entries.principle: The impeachment of a governor and the assumption of office by the deputy governor must comply with the Constitution; the process must be lawful and transparent.
entries.facts: A challenge to the impeachment of the Governor of Kiambu and the assumption of office by the deputy governor.
entries.holding: The impeachment of a governor and the assumption of office by the deputy governor must comply with the Constitution; the process must be lawful and transparent.

entries.title: Waititu Babayao v County Assembly of Kiambu & 6 Others
entries.principle: Impeachment proceedings must be conducted in accordance with the Constitution and the County Governments Act; the courts will review procedural irregularities.
entries.facts: A challenge to the impeachment of the Governor of Kiambu County.
entries.holding: Impeachment proceedings must be conducted in accordance with the Constitution and the County Governments Act; the courts will review procedural irregularities.

entries.title: Kioko v Clerk, Nairobi City County Assembly & 11 Others
entries.principle: The impeachment process is a constitutional mechanism; the county assembly and the Senate must act within their constitutional mandates and afford procedural fairness.
entries.facts: A challenge to the impeachment of the Governor of Nairobi County.
entries.holding: The impeachment process is a constitutional mechanism; the county assembly and the Senate must act within their constitutional mandates and afford procedural fairness.

entries.title: Mohamed & 6 Others v County Assembly of Wajir & 9 Others
entries.principle: The impeachment of a governor must comply with Article 181 of the Constitution and the County Governments Act; the county assembly must afford a fair hearing and follow the prescribed procedure.
entries.facts: A challenge to the impeachment of the Governor of Wajir County.
entries.holding: The impeachment of a governor must comply with Article 181 of the Constitution and the County Governments Act; the county assembly must afford a fair hearing and follow the prescribed procedure.

entries.title: Ombwayo v Clerk of the National Assembly & 3 Others
entries.principle: The impeachment of a Cabinet Secretary must comply with Article 152 of the Constitution; the process must afford procedural fairness and follow the prescribed steps.
entries.facts: A challenge to the impeachment of a Cabinet Secretary.
entries.holding: The impeachment of a Cabinet Secretary must comply with Article 152 of the Constitution; the process must afford procedural fairness and follow the prescribed steps.

entries.title: Law Society of Kenya v Mwenda & 6 Others
entries.principle: The impeachment of a governor and the assumption of office by the deputy governor must comply with the Constitution; the process must be lawful and transparent.
entries.facts: A challenge to the impeachment of the Governor of Nairobi and the assumption of office by the deputy governor.
entries.holding: The impeachment of a governor and the assumption of office by the deputy governor must comply with the Constitution; the process must be lawful and transparent.

entries.title: Parliamentary Service Commission v Wambora & 36 Others
entries.principle: The Supreme Court's jurisdiction over impeachment matters is limited; the Court will not interfere with the constitutional processes of the county assembly and the Senate absent illegality.
entries.facts: An application by the Parliamentary Service Commission in the Wambora impeachment saga.
entries.holding: The Supreme Court's jurisdiction over impeachment matters is limited; the Court will not interfere with the constitutional processes of the county assembly and the Senate absent illegality.

entries.title: Wambora & Another v Speaker of the Senate & Another
entries.principle: The Senate's role in impeachment is to hear and determine the charges; procedural fairness requires adequate notice and an opportunity to be heard.
entries.facts: A challenge to the Senate's role in the impeachment of the Governor of Embu.
entries.holding: The Senate's role in impeachment is to hear and determine the charges; procedural fairness requires adequate notice and an opportunity to be heard.

entries.title: Wambora v Speaker of the County Assembly of Embu & 3 Others
entries.principle: Impeachment proceedings must comply with the Constitution and the County Governments Act; the county assembly must afford the governor a fair hearing before removal.
entries.facts: A challenge to the impeachment of the Governor of Embu County.
entries.holding: Impeachment proceedings must comply with the Constitution and the County Governments Act; the county assembly must afford the governor a fair hearing before removal.
